{{Top|leg}}
The '''Cymbal''',<ref name="Payback">{{StoryCite|story=Payback: The Tale of Dengar|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref> also called '''sounding cymbal''',<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> was a musical instrument played by a member of a [[Turan]] band, in a [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]], around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Payback" /> It was also used as a part of the [[Bontormian klesplong/Legends|Bontormian klesplong]].<ref name="CVD" />
